recipe.name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry with Rice

steps.text: Heat the oil in a heavy bottomed pan; make sure you have a lid for it.
steps.label: heat oil

steps.text: Add the onions and when they start to sizzle add the whole spices and chillies. Cook on a low heat until the onions are starting to brown.
steps.label: fry onion spices

steps.text: Add the garlic and finger chillies to the pan and cook for a minute more.
steps.label: add garlic chilli

steps.text: If the oil has disappeared add a little more, you need the oil to cook the ground spices out.
steps.label: top up oil

steps.text: Add the curry Masala or ground spices to the pan and continue to cook on a low heat for 45 seconds
steps.label: cook curry masala

steps.text: Add the diluted tomato puree, stir in and cook for 30 seconds or so.
steps.label: add tomato puree

steps.text: Add the tomatoes, mango chutney and salt, stir in and bring to a simmer. Turn the heat to the lowest you can (a heat diffuser on gas works a treat) and put the lid on. Leave to cook for around 20 minutes.
steps.label: simmer sauce

steps.text: Take the lid off and stir. If it looks a little dry add a splash of water. Add the Garam Masala. Stir in and put the lid back on. Leave to cook for another 15 minutes.
steps.label: add garam masala

steps.text: After 15 minutes remove the lid and stir. If you like a thick sauce you may want to turn the heat up now and let it reduce down. If the sauce looks a little oily for your taste you can use a ladle to skim some of the oil off.
steps.label: reduce curry

steps.text: Add the chickpeas and spinach, and later add the coconut milk and the juice of half a lemon. Season to taste.
steps.label: add chickpeas spinach

steps.text: Add some coconut milk and a squeeze of lemon, to taste
steps.label: finish with coconut

steps.text: Stir in the fresh coriander and serve over plain boiled rice with a chapatti or roti.
steps.label: serve over rice
